full_judgment:
Md. Fazlur Rahman J: This Reference made under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) by the learned Judge, Druta Bichar Tribunal No. 3, Dhaka seeks confirmation of the sentence of death imposed by him upon the condemned prisoners (1) Saidul @ Saidul Islam (2) Md Adel @ Adil and (3) Badil @ Badar under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code by his Judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 29-10-2003 passed in Druta Bichar Tribunal Case No. 21 of 2003 arising out of GR No. 1116 of 2002 corresponding to Lalbag Police Station Case No. 13 dated 9-4-2002. The condemned prisoners Saidul @ Saidul Islam and Md Adel @ Adil preferred Criminal Appeal No. 4235 of 2003 and also Jail Appeal No. 143 of 2004. During trial condemned prisoner Badil @ Badar was absconding and after conclusion of trial and pronouncement of judgment on 29-10-2003, he was finally apprehended by the police on 4-1-2005. Then he preferred Jail Appeal No. 25 of 2005. The Reference and the appeals which arise out of the same impugned order of conviction and sentence were heard together and are disposed of by this judgment. 

 47. In the result, the Death Reference is rejected. The Criminal Appeal No. 4235 of 2003 and the Jail Appeal No. 143 of 2004 stand dismissed. The order of conviction of accused Saidul @ Saidul Islam and Md Adel @ Adil is hereby upheld with modification of the sentence from the sentence of death, which is committed to imprisonment for life. They may be released from the condemned cell and be kept in custody with other prisoners in accordance with law. The Jail Appeal No. 25 of 2005 is allowed. The order of conviction and sentence, insofar it relates to accused Badil @ Badar is hereby set aside. He is acquitted of the charge of murder levelled against him under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code and he be released forthwith if not wanted in connection with any other case.
